disclosure: This curated, dated catalog is not a live availability feed, service enrollment, or verified community roster. Source commits identify public project text; they do not establish partnerships, permission, field completion or canonical adoption. Every community and project retains its own authority.

entries.title: Jubilee Circuit — The Road Brings the Feast
entries.summary: A published music-first field kit connects voluntary festival, church and community gathering ideas to locally approved useful work. Ghana and Minnesota are candidate sites, not enrolled partners.
entries.firstCheck: Can one willing host and independent local steward review a two-hour gathering and a consented song seed?

entries.title: Porchlight Commons — Minnesota ↔ Ghana
entries.summary: An organizational HOLD-card desk compares local procurement, remote donations and knowledge transfer for community-selected food, power and communication needs. No live matching, shipping or provider enrollment.
entries.firstCheck: Which organization-level need would a locally authorized receiving steward choose to describe?

entries.title: The Garden — community food access and federation
entries.summary: Waseca food-access and producer-direct ideas explore a locally governed grocery, pilot shelves, grower connections and reusable intercommunity learning. No cooperative or venue consent is implied.
entries.firstCheck: What decision or small practical test do the independent grocery organizers actually want help reviewing?

entries.title: Night Desk — useful work after dark
entries.summary: A public night-work desk explores bounded tasks, stewardship and distinct stages from proposed help to independently reviewed results. A web page is not an emergency dispatch or verified service.
entries.firstCheck: What safe, reversible task can someone prepare or review tonight without unapproved access to people or sites?

entries.title: reLATTE COMMUTER — farm and cooperative communication
entries.summary: A tested library prototype expresses source change → signed crossing → receiver-owned HOLD/ADMIT/REFUSE → idempotent destination action. It is not connected to a real farm, email account or live worker.
entries.firstCheck: What source system, receiver permission and destination adapter could an operator safely test with synthetic records?

entries.title: Weaves → we'ves — work that inherits
entries.summary: The local JAR;VIS operator notebook separates a possible task, voluntary stated commitment, reported result, separate review and reusable candidate method. This is not public verified fulfillment.
entries.firstCheck: Can a small task yield a recorded report and independent review without assuming the participant is authenticated?

entries.title: Reviewer discovery and voluntary stewardship
entries.summary: An owner-approved experimental reviewer role portal supports private opt-in interest and operator screening. A role application is not verified identity, independent review or appointment.
entries.firstCheck: Which question requires a reviewer, and who may independently approve that person's scope?

entries.title: Still Here — survivor-led practical support
entries.summary: A survivor-first front-door and voluntary stewardship concept preserves privacy, safeguarding and the right to start with a small task. It is not an active referral, peer matching or crisis service.
entries.firstCheck: What safeguarding and responsible-human review must exist before inviting vulnerable people into a shared service?

entries.title: Static Live and the listening room
entries.summary: Static Live describes consented performance packets, stage projections and attributable music; the public listening room carries songs and letters. Neither implies permission to reuse anyone else's recording.
entries.firstCheck: Which artist or community voluntarily licenses a song seed and chooses how replies may be recorded, credited or shared?

entries.title: Coalition of Care and provider-first practical assistance
entries.summary: A provider-first homelessness response on-ramp proposes a small, authorized neighbor-help task with an independent lived-experience reviewer. This is not an official coalition program or provider service.
entries.firstCheck: Which existing provider would review one task without transferring private client records or case management?

entries.title: Abundent Switchboard — public doors
entries.summary: The Abundent Switchboard lists independent experiments and marks preview or repair status separately. A link is a door, not shared governance or a promise of operational service.
entries.firstCheck: Which existing working door serves the particular question, and is its public hostname actually reachable?

entries.title: Becoming — organizations that don't exist yet
entries.summary: A public open-chair identity for emerging organizations and ideas; it does not invent staff, legal status, founding history or partner approvals.
entries.firstCheck: What concrete first invitation would let another person voluntarily help shape an unformed organization?
